claim: Eden and Clare screwcapped their whole category in 2000.
because: In 2000 a group of 13 or 14 Clare Valley producers, led by Jeffrey Grosset, jointly bottled their Rieslings under Stelvin screwcap. It was one group of producers, not the whole Riesling category, and not a joint Eden Valley and Clare decision. The Eden Valley link for this question is earlier: Yalumba's own screwcap trials with Pewsey Vale Riesling in the 1970s.
fix: Yalumba trialled screwcaps on Pewsey Vale Riesling in the 1970s; in 2000 a group of Clare Valley producers led by Jeffrey Grosset moved their Rieslings to screwcap together.
